author: w459
reproduction: For the same variable sites, gamma_b/gamma_f=exp(K B_b)/E_f exp(K B_b), with 0<=B_b<=m. The log ratio lies in [-Km,Km], so both KL directions are <=Km; KL convexity gives the mixture bound. DLR conditioning gives the infinite-state marginal bound.
remaining_gap: Surface-order KL carries no positive critical agreement-density separation; pinning variable sites would invalidate reverse KL.

author: w459
reproduction: Gibbs variational inequality yields P_n(K+h)-P_n(K)>=h e_n^sign-delta_n^sign for either h sign. Taking n->infinity first, h->0 second, gives P'_+>=e_+ and P'_-<=e_-.
remaining_gap: No vanishing-KL pair with e_+>e_- at K_c has been constructed. An energy slope jump alone is not yet the source's critical magnetization assertion.

author: w459
reproduction: Chain rule conditions on outside spins; induced matching makes pair factors conditionally independent. Convexity and color-permutation averaging lower-bound each uniform pair KL by c_q(K). For full-support pi, the pair odds ratio is exp(2K) versus 1 for pi tensor pi; four-cell TV control gives TV>=min(pi)^2 tanh(K/2), then Pinsker gives the stated KL lower bound.
remaining_gap: Excludes fixed product trial laws only; says nothing about correlated critical trial states or critical order.

author: w459
reproduction: Expand Z=sum_{A subset E}(exp(K)-1)^|A| q^k(A); k(A)>=|V|-|A| gives Z>=q^|V|(1+(exp(K)-1)/q)^|E|. Equality is termwise for forests and strict for a cycle when K>0. Directly compute score differences: entropy=-(q-2)log(q-1)/q and agreement square=(q-2)^2/[q(q-1)], canceled at K_MF=(q-1)log(q-1)/[d(q-2)].
remaining_gap: Mean-field score equality does not locate K_c or make product laws critical Gibbs laws; source conjecture still untouched.

author: w460
reproduction: In ordered coupling event discrepancy implies some edge in finite support F differs, giving delta<=sum edge-marginal gaps. For B_R, |E(B_R)|=d(2R)(2R+1)^(d-1). Under theta_w>=eta, theta_f=0 choose R so free A_R<=eta/2; symmetry gives edge gap>=eta/(2m_R). Edwards-Sokal opens a same-spin edge with probability p, hence agreement gap=edge gap/p.
remaining_gap: The uniform-in-volume critical hypothesis theta_w>=eta with theta_f=0 is unproved for the missing C0048 pairs; the free condition is an additional premise.

author: w460
reproduction: Boundary recoloring gives 0<=log Z_free-log Z_fixed<=b log q+2d K b=o(|B_N|). For either boundary condition, convex tangent inequality survives volume limit. Bulk edge averages converge by free/wired domain monotonicity and an interior-R sandwich; limits a_f,a_w are subgradients of the common pressure P. Therefore P'_+-P'_->=a_w-a_f>=d delta/(p m).
remaining_gap: No positive critical finite-event gap is supplied; a pressure jump is only a conditional consequence and needs a magnetization bridge to solve the primary conjecture.

author: w460
reproduction: For a path of L edges free edges are iid with alpha=p/[p+q(1-p)]. Endpoint identification multiplies free configuration weight by q iff all edges open and by 1 otherwise, up to a common factor. Thus the edge gap is (q-1)(1-alpha)alpha^L/[1+(q-1)alpha^L]. At q=3,p=1/2, gaps L=1:1/4 and L=4:1/172, tending to zero.
remaining_gap: The path lies outside d>=3; it refutes the general finite-gap-to-limit inference, not C0048.

author: w460
reproduction: With x=exp(2nt), (2x+1)/(x+2) is in [1/2,2], so sup|g_n-f_n|<=log2/n. At t=0, derivatives are 4/3 and 2/3; both limits are 2 max(t,0).
remaining_gap: Abstract finite-state counterexample; no assertion about Potts realization.
